think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range/default. 2) Check whether any numeric values (commonly 0 or -1) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable a feature, auto-tune, unlimited) rather than just “smaller/larger”. 3) If such mode-switching values exist, classify as a special knob and list them; otherwise classify as non-special.
